top_signals.title: Gold Falls Below $4,000 as Traders Assess Inflation, Fed Remarks
top_signals.summary: Gold slipped, extending losses triggered by a high US inflation print and hawkish remarks from Federal Reserve officials that reinforced expectations of a December rate hike.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
